item.title: check_scope_violations embeds literal \n in developer retry prompt — file list garbled
item.intent: Developer retry_extra_prompt must contain real newlines in the scope violations file list, not literal backslash-n sequences
steps: Locate violations string accumulation in check_scope_violations: violations="${violations}  - $file\n" (literal backslash-n)
Confirm that scope_report=$(check_scope_violations) captures this garbled output in _run_validation_cycle
Confirm that scope_report is embedded directly into retry_extra_prompt string without printf %b interpretation
Fix: change violations accumulation from literal \n to real newline using violations+="  - $file"$'\n'
Verify the non-strict path in check_scope_violations also benefits (stdout to terminal now displays correctly)
Run shellcheck — confirm zero new warnings
acceptanceCriteria: In strict scope mode with 2+ violated files, the developer retry_extra_prompt contains each violated filename on its own separate line (no literal \n sequences visible)
